description: This file defines the class em_network_topo_t which manages network topology data and operations for a mesh network, including functions to find topologies by MAC address or data model, add/remove topologies, and encode topology data. It serves as an interface for network topology management in a mesh network system.

classes.name: em_network_topo_t
classes.description: Represents a network topology, providing methods to find, add, remove, and encode network topologies within a mesh network system.

methods.name: find_topology_by_bh_associated
methods.description: Finds the network topology associated with a given MAC address of a station.

methods.name: find_topology_by_bh_associated
methods.description: Finds the network topology associated with a given data model.

methods.name: find_topology_by_bss_mac
methods.description: Finds the network topology associated with a specific BSS MAC address.

methods.name: print_topology
methods.description: Recursively prints the network topology tree.

methods.name: find_topology
methods.description: Finds the network topology based on the provided EasyMesh data.

methods.name: dm_easy_mesh_t * get_data_model()
methods.description: Retrieves the data model instance used in the network topology.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new mesh network to the system.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specified easy mesh network.

methods.name: add_network_topo
methods.description: Adds a network topology to the specified EasyMesh instance.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes the given cJSON object representing the topology.

methods.name: em_network_topo_t (constructor)
methods.description: Creates a network topology object from an EasyMesh instance.

methods.name: ~em_network_topo_t (destructor)
methods.description: Destroys the network topology object, cleaning up resources.
